qualitative.note: Fails Gate 1 (Rejected – G1 Understandability). Belgian investment holding company heavily concentrated in unlisted venture capital funds (LP stakes) and private growth-stage technology equity (e.g. ByteDance, unlisted startups). Portfolio valuation is based on opaque internal marks and third-party fund valuations that are not verifiable from outside public financial statements.
qualitative.evidence: Sofina's net asset value is largely driven by private venture capital / growth equity commitments (Sofina Direct and Sofina Private Funds backing VC managers like Sequoia). Underlying private assets carry opaque unit economics, illiquid marks, and valuation write-down risks (as demonstrated by Byju's) that cannot be independently audited or verified from reported figures.
